decisions.quote: When motivated reasoning was measured by thought listings (in addition to the original questionnaire items) and when the analytic estimation provided greater power, the Model of Motivated Interpersonal Forgiveness was replicated.
decisions.reason: The authors state an unambiguous overall verdict that the findings and model of Donovan and Priester (2017) were replicated using both the original questionnaire items and the thought-listing extension (specifically thought negativity) under the more focused analytic estimation; the exploratory test showing that thought positivity did not mediate is presented as clarifying how motivated reasoning operates rather than as a failed or mixed replication.
